# Vendored external schemas — OGC API - Records

Third-party schemas the CDH tooling validates against. **Not part of the CDH
standard** — kept outside `spec/` so `scripts/_ajv.js` does not auto-load them.

## `recordGeoJSON.schema.json`

A self-contained, strict-JSON-Schema-ready copy of the OGC API - Records **1.0**
record schema, used to validate CDH records routed to OGC API - Records.

- **Source (pinned):** <https://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/records/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/recordGeoJSON.yaml>
- **Generated by:** `vendor.mjs` — do not hand-edit.

### Why vendored + patched (not fetched live)

- **Pinned + deterministic.** Validation is reproducible and offline, against a
  named spec version — the same discipline records use for `cdh_schema_version`
  and STAC extension URLs. Validating against upstream `master` would make CI
  non-deterministic and network-dependent for no benefit.
- **Patched for strict validation.** Upstream writes `geometry` / `properties` /
  `time` as `oneOf: [{type: object, nullable: true}, {$ref: realThing}]` — an
  OpenAPI idiom for "nullable" that a strict JSON Schema validator rejects on
  *valid* records (a real object matches both branches). `vendor.mjs` rewrites
  those decoy branches to `{type: "null"}`, so `null` and the real value each
  match exactly one branch. External `$ref`s are also bundled to internal refs.

### Regenerate (only when bumping the OGC Records version)

```sh
npm i --no-save @apidevtools/json-schema-ref-parser   # build-only; not kept in package.json
node external/ogc-records/vendor.mjs
```

Then bump the `VERSION` constant in `vendor.mjs` for a new OGC release. Watch
<https://github.com/opengeospatial/ogcapi-records/releases> for new versions.
